description: Writes down a message being prepared, so it can be finished later from anywhere. Pass "from" to start one; pass its id to write into it again, where the fields you leave out keep the value they had. Saving sends nothing: send_email is what sends.

bcc.description: Who else receives it without the others being told. A blind copy is kept on the sending alone: the thread records the visible recipients only.

body.description: The text of the message, as the contact will read it. Plain text, in their language.

cc.description: Who else receives it, in copy. Everyone on the mail sees these.

draft_id.description: The id of the unsent message, as list_compose_drafts gives it.

from.description: The address it will be sent from, from list_sender_addresses. Needed to start a message, ignored afterwards.

subject.description: The subject line, up to 255 characters.

name: save_compose_draft
title: Keep a message for later
